'''Lane Vizla''' was a member of [[Clan Vizla]] and a distant cousin of [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]]. Around [[3625 BBY]], Lane partook in the [[Showdown on Ruhnuk]]. Following the battle, she was tasked with cleaning up remaining [[Hidden Chain]] forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], and later helped the [[Alliance Commander]] repair [[B3-S1]].

==Biography==
The youngest relative of [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]], Lane Vizla was a child when Shae led [[Clan Vizla]] to [[Tracyn Island]] on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. She spent her formative years teaching herself to repair and enhance the various machines used by her clan, such as state-of-the-art [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and elemental [[Force field/Legends|forcefields]]. She also saw firsthand her cousin's indifference towards war and was skeptical towards Shae's ability to lead the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]. Regardless, Vizla acknowledged that Shae was the rightful [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|exp=lots|Lane Vizla}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Lane Vizla is a character from ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''. She first appeared as the contact for the bonus series following the "Showdown on Ruhnuk" storyline. She can be flirted with by players of either [[Gender/Legends|sex]].<ref name="Prize">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Eyes on the Prize|[[Ruhnuk]]}}</ref> Upon completing the repairs to B3-S1 during the Ventures mission "Burc'ya Veman", the player will have the option to flirt with Lane once again, which will lead to a kiss.<ref name="Ventures">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Burc'ya Veman|[[Ruhnuk]]}}</ref>

In '''Game Update 7.8: Pursuit of Ruin''', mission "Hoth Pursuit", if the player had interacted with Lane prior to starting the mission, [[Rass Ordo]] will mention that she had loaned one of her probe droids to aid them in finding [[Greb Besrik]] in the ''[[Star of Coruscant]]''. If the player hadn't interacted with Lane at all, Rass will vaguely mention her as a friend in the dialogue.<ref name="Hoth Pursuit">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Hoth Pursuit|[[Hoth/Legends]]}}</ref>
